title: Acute arrhythmia
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Fictional scenario specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.
learning_objectives: Verify an alarm at the bedside and check the patient first.
Keep resuscitation equipment available during antiarrhythmics.

sources.use: label: heart block, asystole, resuscitative measures

expected_actions.text: Verify an alarm or unusual rhythm at the bedside and check the patient before acting.
Keep resuscitation equipment immediately available when adenosine is given and watch the ECG for block or asystole.
During amiodarone, report hypotension, bradycardia or heart block.
